preconditions.description: The number of queries q must be between 1 and 500,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= typei <= 2 for typei, vi in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query type must be either 1 or 2.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= vi <= len(vertices) for typei, vi in queries if typei == 1)
preconditions.description: For type 1 queries, the parent vertex index vi must exist in the current set of vertices.

postconditions.description: The output must match the expected value of the penalty for each query of the second type.
The number of outputs must equal the number of type 2 queries.

invariants.description: The number of vertices must be equal to the total number of queries minus the number of type 2 queries plus one.
